## Description
**What**: Update implementation-plan/SKILL.md so that for any task adding, modifying, or removing a dso-config.conf key it emits a separate child sub-task (testing_mode GREEN) titled 'Document <key> in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md' carrying a depends_on link to the parent task, superseding the generic doc-router path for config keys.
**Why**: This is the same artifact-desync pattern that motivated the epic (release.sh + marketplace.json); a config key and its reference doc must update together.
**Scope**:
- IN: add/modify/remove key detection in implementation-plan/SKILL.md; child sub-task emission with depends_on to the parent; suppression of the duplicate generic doc-router documentation task for config keys.
- OUT: the inference-gate config key itself (draft-6); reviewer Category 8 pass.

## Done Definitions

- An implementation-plan run on a task that adds a dso-config.conf key yields a child sub-task titled Document <key> in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md whose depends_on points to the parent task id ← Satisfies: sc-4
- An implementation-plan run on a task that modifies or removes a dso-config.conf key yields the same paired documentation child sub-task ← Satisfies: sc-4
- For a config-key task the generic doc-router documentation task is not emitted, so no duplicate documentation task exists ← Satisfies: sc-4
- The emitted child sub-task carries testing_mode GREEN ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations

- [Sequencing] This story is sequenced before the inference-gate story (draft-6) so SC8's key documentation follows the established config-key/doc pairing pattern.
- [Coordination] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md is edited at story-run time across many config-adding epics; coordinate key namespacing rather than locking the file at epic-merge time.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO planner, I want implementation-plan to emit a paired config-key documentation sub-task, so that every config-key change updates CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md atomically.
